name: SharedWorkspaceLinks
description: A collection of the SharedWorkspaceLink objects in the current shared workspace.
example:
Dim swsLinks As Office.SharedWorkspaceLinks
    Set swsLinks = ActiveWorkbook.SharedWorkspace.Links
    MsgBox "There are " & swsLinks.Count & _
        " link(s) in the current shared workspace.", _
        vbInformation + vbOKOnly, _
        "Collection Information"
    Set swsLinks = Nothing

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SharedWorkspaceLinks object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SharedWorkspaceLinks object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a SharedWorkspaceLink object from the Links collection of the shared workspace. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the SharedWorkspaceLinks object. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the SharedWorkspaceLinks object. Read-only.

properties.name: ItemCountExceeded
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value that indicates whether the number of SharedWorkspaceLinks items in the collection has exceeded the 99 that can be displayed in the Shared Workspace task pane. Read-only.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(URL As String, [Description As Variant], [Notes As Variant]) As SharedWorkspaceLink
methods.description: Adds a link to the list of links in a shared workspace.

parameters.name: URL
parameters.description: The address of the website to which a link is being added.
